title: Mañanera: Sheinbaum Shows BTS National Palace Video; Cites ~50% Homicide Drop; Tatiana Clouthier Resigns from IME for Nuevo León Race; CFE Pipeline Investment
detail: At the May 7, 2026 mañanera, President Claudia Sheinbaum covered five major topics: (1) BTS National Palace Visit: Sheinbaum showed a video of her May 6 meeting with South Korean music group BTS at the National Palace, where approximately 50,000 ARMY fans had gathered outside. She directly told reporters not to 'politicize' the visit, defending it as a cultural and tourism promotion event. Sheinbaum confirmed BTS will return to Mexico in 2027 for a new tour. The group's visit generated massive domestic media coverage and social media engagement, underscoring Mexico's soft-power profile ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. (2) Security Metrics vs. Trump Pressure: Sheinbaum pushed back against Trump administration rhetoric calling for U.S. military action inside Mexico, citing a nearly 50% drop in intentional homicides since the start of her administration, 2,500 clandestine drug labs dismantled, and a continuing decline in fentanyl trafficking volumes — adding to the 644 labs and 2+ million fentanyl pills data cited in prior mañaneras. (3) Tatiana Clouthier Departure: Sheinbaum announced that Tatiana Clouthier Carrillo — former Economy Secretary under AMLO (2021–2022), former federal deputy, and co-architect of the 2018 coalition strategy — resigned as head of the Institute of Mexicans Abroad (IME, Instituto de los Mexicanos en el Exterior) to compete for Morena's gubernatorial candidacy in Nuevo León ahead of the 2027 state elections. Nuevo León is a key industrial state governed by opposition Movimiento Ciudadano (MC); Morena is seeking to flip it in the 17-governorship midterm cycle. (4) CFE Natural Gas Pipeline Investment: CFE Director Emilia Calleja Alor presented an investment package to expand and modernize Mexico's natural gas pipeline infrastructure. The initiative addresses the country's approximately 75% natural gas import dependency from the U.S. and is part of the administration's broader energy sovereignty agenda, consistent with the April 2026 unconventional gas technical committee launched after Sheinbaum's BlackRock meeting. (5) Isabel Díaz Ayuso Visit Defense: Sheinbaum defended the visit of Madrid regional president Isabel Díaz Ayuso (Partido Popular), saying Mexico has freedom of expression and the meeting was conducted freely — dismissing opposition framing of the visit as diplomatically sensitive.

media.caption: Sheinbaum May 7 mañanera: BTS National Palace visit, ~50% homicide drop cited vs. Trump intervention rhetoric, Tatiana Clouthier IME resignation for Nuevo León race, CFE pipeline investment
